operatorProperties.code:
def process(reportsByType) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = reportsByType.copy()

    # The file has a blank first row and the real header on row index 1.
    df = df.dropna(how='all')
    df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.columns]

    # Detect and apply the in-table header row (contains 'Year')
    header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().eq('Year')].iloc[0]
    df = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().ne('Year')].copy()
    df.columns = [str(x).strip() for x in header_row.tolist()]

    # Keep only year + identity theft
    df = df[['Year', 'Identity Theft']].copy()
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
    df['Identity Theft'] = (
        df['Identity Theft']
        .astype(str)
        .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
        .str.strip()
    )
    df['Identity Theft'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Identity Theft'], errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Year', 'Identity Theft'])

    it2001 = df.loc[df['Year'] == 2001, 'Identity Theft'].iloc[0]
    it2024 = df.loc[df['Year'] == 2024, 'Identity Theft'].iloc[0]

    ratio = it2024 / it2001

    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'identity_theft_2001': it2001,
        'identity_theft_2024': it2024,
        'ratio_2024_vs_2001': ratio,
        'ratio_rounded_4dp': round(ratio, 4)
    }])
